_ghi: EN-ALL GĐ 8 — bản phủ tiếng Anh của các lớp tháng trong "Thời gian tới" (ban biên tập, chờ người bản xứ duyệt). Câu phong thuỷ trùng ý tuan.pt.* (en/loi/nhip_ngay.json).

tam_hop.nhan: The {chi_thang} month forms a triad with your {chi_tuoi} sign
tam_hop.loi: Folk tradition sees this as a month for meeting like-minded people. Good for bringing others in on a project and saying yes to a partnership.

luc_hop.nhan: The {chi_thang} month pairs with your {chi_tuoi} sign
luc_hop.loi: Folk tradition sees this as a month when help arrives at the right moment. Good for asking for help, meeting old contacts and having difficult conversations.

trung.loi: A month of your own zodiac sign. Folk tradition advises keeping to your routines and having a clear plan before you act.

xung.nhan: The {chi_thang} month clashes with your {chi_tuoi} sign
xung.loi: Folk tradition advises slowing down a beat on big matters this month: read paperwork carefully, do not rush to sign, keep the peace at home.

hinh.nhan: The {chi_thang} month is in punishment with your {chi_tuoi} sign
hinh.loi: Folk tradition sees this as a month of small frictions. Speak more slowly, and write down who does what on shared tasks.

hai.loi: Folk tradition sees this as a month for misunderstandings. Confirm arrangements in writing and ask before you blame.

binh.nhan: The {chi_thang} month and your {chi_tuoi} sign: neutral
binh.loi: Neither a match nor a clash by the zodiac. Follow your own plan for the month.

sao_tot.1: good news, meeting people who help

phong_thuy.goc_hop: The {phuong} corner of your home is both a direction that suits you and the spot this month's good star visits ({y}). It is a good place for your desk, a reading chair or anything that needs focus.
phong_thuy.goc_tot: This month's good star ({y}) visits the {phuong} corner. Keeping that corner bright, airy and tidy is enough.
phong_thuy.goc_yen: Keep the {phuong} corner quiet this month: no drilling, no piling up heavy things, keep it tidy.
phong_thuy.goc_yen_hai: Keep the {a} and {b} corners quiet this month: no drilling, no piling up heavy things, keep them tidy.
phong_thuy.thieu_gioi: Add your gender to your profile to see which corner of your home suits you each month.
phong_thuy.nam_goc_hop: In {nam}, the {phuong} corner of your home is both a direction that suits you and the spot the year's good star visits ({y}). It is the place worth putting your desk, bed or study corner for the whole year.
phong_thuy.nam_goc_tot: In {nam}, the year's good star ({y}) visits the {phuong} corner. Keep that corner bright, airy and tidy all year.
phong_thuy.nam_can_cu: Yearly stars for {nam} by Xuan Kong ({tam} in the centre){chi_tiet}; Gua {quai} from your birth year and gender (Eight Mansions).

ngay_dep.loi: Good days to start things this month that do not clash with your sign: {ds}.
ngay_dep.khong_co: No day this month fully suits starting something for your sign — move big plans to next month or check the Good Days page carefully.
ngay_dep.can_cu: Almanac: days with "opening a business" in the Good-for list and not in the Avoid list, a favourable day officer, no clash with your sign, and no folk taboo day.

noi_bat.tieu_de: Months where the most readings agree it is favourable: {ds}
noi_bat.loi: Over the next 12 months, these are the months where several readings agree it is favourable ({ly_do}). Good to keep for something you want to start or close.
noi_bat.di_cham_tieu_de: Months to slow down a beat: {ds}
noi_bat.di_cham_loi: In these months several readings agree on caution ({ly_do}). Prepare big plans more carefully and leave extra time.
noi_bat.can_cu: Counted from each layer already worked out: zodiac match with your sign, the month's good star in a corner that suits you, and the month's Zi Wei / Bazi level. Not a score.
